scope: Opt-in receiver startup after the existing system startup engine establishes backend and Worker readiness; no additional scheduler or receiver crash-restart loop.

negativeCoverage: missing or disabled startup approval produces no receiver dispatch
config hash or startup/live authority mismatch fails closed
fresh launch occurs once and subsequent process receipt reuses the singleton
process identity conflict fails without takeover
manual receiver stop disables startup under the service mutex
isolated system startup cannot call the production receiver
receiver startup failure is surfaced without stopping already-ready system services

productionAdoption.requires: Controlled Worker and Django controller release, then EnableDingTalkStartup and actual system-start/connected-log readback.

limitations: Existing login startup requires the original Windows user and DPAPI identity; not unattended pre-login execution.
Receiver process running does not prove Stream connection or message delivery.
Receiver-only crash recovery remains manual; no unbounded authentication retry or missed-slot replay.
